items.h: Fantasy buzz: Should you deal for one of the five most traded players in fantasy?
items.s: Meet the most traded players in fantasy football this week, and whether you should hold or trade for them too.

items.h: Will help fill in for departed Allen
items.s: Head coach Shane Steichen said that Dulin will be one of the Colts receivers who absorb the snaps vacated by Keenan Allen, who was traded to the 49ers on Tuesday, Jake Arthur of Roundtable.io reports. Steichen also mentioned Deion Burks and Nick Westbrook-Ikhine as other candidates to fill in at the outside receiver spot opposite Laquon Treadwell, while noting that Anthony Gould will serve as the Colts' starting slot receiver after the team also traded Josh Downs to the Chiefs on Tuesday. With Alec Pierce's (heel) return from injured reserve seemingly not imminent, Dulin could have a prime opportunity to see extended snaps over the next few weeks, provided he can hold off the likes of…

items.h: Fantasy buzz: Malik Willis placed on IR, are there any Dolphins you should start?
items.s: What does the Miami Dolphins' fantasy football outlook show with starting QB Malik Willis placed on IR?

items.h: Ashton Dulin is Worth Stashing Following Trade Deadline
items.s: Indianapolis Colts wide receiver Ashton Dulin is expected to see an increased role following Tuesday's trade deadline. The Colts made some moves at the deadline and traded both Keenan Allen and Josh Downs. Now, Dulin might be the top or second target in Indy following the trades. This season, Dulin has recorded four receptions for 84 yards with one touchdown in eight games. He has been buried on the depth chart, so his impact has been minimal. The expectation is that he's going to see increased opportunities down the stretch of the season. The 29-year-old could be worth stashing in deep leagues with his role likely expanding.

items.h: Ashton Dulin hauls in 55-yard TD in Week 9
items.s: Ashton Dulin caught one of his two targets for a 55-yard touchdown in a 27-23 loss to the Cowboys in Week 9. Dulin brought in Daniel Jones' lone TD pass in the third quarter to cut the Cowboys' lead to 20-17 after the extra point. Dulin only has four catches on nine targets this season, although his role might grow if the Colts wind up trading Josh Downs or Keenan Allen. Dulin will take on the Dolphins in Week 10.

items.h: Long TD in loss to Dallas
items.s: Dulin caught one of two targets for a 55-yard touchdown in Sunday's 27-23 loss to the Cowboys. He added three rushing yards on one attempt. Dulin caught a screen pass at the line of scrimmage and raced all the way down the left sideline for the touchdown on his big play to pull the Colts within three points at the end of the third quarter. He still ran just six routes on Daniel Jones' 38 dropbacks against Dallas, leaving Dulin out of the fantasy picture unless the Colts make some trades at the position before Tuesday's deadline.

items.h: Limited in practice again Thursday
items.s: Dulin (hamstring) was a limited participant in practice Thursday. That's two straight limited sessions to begin the week for Dulin after he missed the Colts' past two games due to a hamstring issue. The veteran wideout appears to be making progress in his recovery, as he didn't practice at all during Week 5 and Week 6 prep. Dulin's likelihood of returning for Sunday's matchup in Minnesota should gain clarity with the release of Friday's injury report and game designations.

items.h: Ashton Dulin (hamstring) considered limited Thursday
items.s: Ashton Dulin (hamstring) was considered a limited participant at practice on Thursday. Dulin was only able to participate in Thursday's practice in a limited fashion, thanks to the hamstring injury he's dealing with. He may play in Week 7, but fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to do much even if active against the Vikings.

items.h: Limited practice Wednesday
items.s: Dulin (hamstring) was a limited participant at the Colts' practice Wednesday. Dulin was able to return to practice for the first time since suffering a hamstring injury in Week 4. The wide receiver will have two more chances to log a full practice before potentially returning to action Sunday versus the Vikings.

items.h: Ashton Dulin (hamstring) limited participant Wednesday
items.s: Ashton Dulin (hamstring) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday. Dulin has been out for a little while due to a hamstring issue that he's dealing with, but he was able to return to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday. He won't be fantasy relevant even if he's back in the lineup in Week 7, however.

items.h: Ruled out for Sunday
items.s: Dulin (hamstring) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Titans, Joel A. Erickson of The Indianapolis Star reports. Dulin was unable to participate in any Week 6 prep sessions. The wide receiver will miss a second consecutive game as he focuses on recovering from his hamstring issue. Deion Burks is set to be the No. 4 wide receiver for the Colts again.

items.h: Ashton Dulin (hamstring) unavailable for Sunday
items.s: Ashton Dulin (hamstring) will be unavailable for Sunday's game against the Tennessee Titans. Dulin is not going to be available to play on Sunday, which comes as no surprise, given that his hamstring injury left him sidelined at practice all week. His absence may lead to a bit more work for Keenan Allen against the Titans.

items.h: Still not practicing Thursday
items.s: Dulin (hamstring) did not participate at practice Thursday. Dulin sat out Sunday's game at Pittsburgh due to a hamstring injury, and he now appears to be trending towards missing a second game because of it. Unless he's able to return to practice in some capacity Friday, it's unlikely he'll be available in Week 6 versus the Titans.

items.h: Dulin (hamstring) did not participate in Wednesday's practice session.
items.s: Dulin has not been cleared to practice or play since sustaining a hamstring injury during the Colts' Week 4 win over the Commanders in London. He'll have two more chances to log at least a limited practice ahead of the Colts' AFC South showdown against the Titans on Sunday.

items.h: Dulin (hamstring) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Steelers.
items.s: Dulin likely sustained his hamstring injury in the Colts' Week 4 win over the Commanders. The wide receiver has not practiced since appearing on Wednesday's injury report with the issue and will likely need to miss some time. Deion Burks is set to be the No. 4 option at wide receiver in Dulin's absence.

items.h: Dulin (hamstring) did not participate at practice Thursday.
items.s: Dulin popped up on the Colts' injury report Wednesday with a hamstring issue, and his availability for Week 5 is now in serious doubt. He'll probably have to return to practice in some capacity Friday to have a realistic chance of suiting up Sunday at Pittsburgh.

items.h: Dulin didn't participate in Wednesday's practice due to a hamstring injury.
items.s: Dulin missed two consecutive games due to an ankle injury before being cleared to play against the Commanders in Week 4, when he caught three of six targets for 29 yards. He's now working through a different lower-body injury, but he'll have two more opportunities to return to practice ahead of Sunday's road game against the Steelers.

items.h: Dulin (ankle) is active for Sunday's game against the Commanders in London.
items.s: Though he had been listed as questionable heading into the weekend, Dulin had always appeared likely to put an end to his two-game absence after practicing fully Thursday and Friday. Dulin projects to make his biggest impact on special teams when the Colts are at full strength at receiver, but he'll be needed to handle a depth role on offense Week 4 while fellow wideouts Keenan Allen (groin) and Darius Slayton (coach's decision) are inactive.

items.h: Dulin (ankle) was a full participant in practice Thursday.
items.s: Dulin practiced for the first time since suffering an ankle injury that kept him out the past two games. While the 29-year-old split time on offense and special teams in Week 1, he could see more reps in the former capacity Sunday as a depth piece with Alec Pierce (heel, IR) unavailable. However, Keenan Allen (groin), Josh Downs, and Laquon Treadwell should still see reps before the eighth-year pro, although a downgrade on the part of Allen would bump Dulin up another notch on the depth chart.

items.h: Dulin (ankle) is not practicing Wednesday, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.
items.s: Dulin has missed the past two games, and his practice week ahead of Week 4 is off on the wrong foot. With Alec Pierce (heel/IR) also out last Sunday against the Texans, the Colts used a three-wide set of Laquon Treadwell, Josh Downs and Keenan Allen.

items.h: Dulin (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Texans, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.
items.s: Dulin will be sidelined for a second consecutive week due to an ankle injury, which also prevented him from participating in any practices during Week 3 prep. Alec Pierce (heel) will also be sidelined, leaving Josh Downs, Keenan Allen, Darius Slayton, Laquon Treadwell and Deion Burks as the healthy wide receivers on the Colts' active roster heading into Sunday' AFC South showdown.

items.h: Dulin (ankle) did not practice Thursday.
items.s: Dulin didn't suit up for the 33-30 overtime loss to the Chiefs in Week 2 due to an ankle injury. He missed practice Wednesday and Thursday, so he's currently not trending favorably toward a return for Sunday's meeting against Houston. If Dulin can't play in Week 3, Seth McGowan could see more return duties on special teams. That would also apply to Anthony Gould, assuming he gets elevated off the practice squad once again. There's also a chance both players could see additional action on the receiving end, considering Alec Pierce is battling a heel issue that is expected to land him on…

items.h: Dulin (ankle) is listed as out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs, Kevin Bowen of 107.5 The Fan Indianapolis reports.
items.s: Dulin won't suit up versus the Chiefs, with head coach Shane Steichen labeling the wideout as "week-to-week." While Dulin is sidelined, Seth McGowan should handle most of the return duties. Laquon Treadwell also figures to see extra playing time behind Josh Downs, Keenan Allen and Alec Pierce (heel).

items.h: Dulin (ankle) did not practice Thursday, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.
items.s: Dulin missed a second consecutive practice Thursday because of an ankle injury. The 29-year-old wideout was held without a catch in Sunday's 41-23 loss to the Ravens. He also saw action as a member of special teams, as expected. If Dulin can't suit up for the Week 2 meeting with the Chiefs, Seth McGowan may be even busier returning kicks.

items.h: Dulin (ankle) did not participate in Wednesday's practice.
items.s: Dulin likely suffered his ankle injury in the Colts' 41-23 loss to the Ravens on Sunday. The wide receiver is the team's starting kick returner and second punt returner as well as the No. 4 option on offense. If Dulin must miss time due to injury, the Colts will have many holes in the roster to fill. The franchise will likely elevate someone from the practice squad to help manage the load on special teams in the event Dulin is ruled out of next Sunday's contest against the Chiefs.

items.h: Dulin may play more on special teams after the Colts signed Keenan Allen this summer, Nathan Brown of The Indianapolis Star reports.
items.s: A thin depth chart put Dulin in position for a top-three role, but the Colts now hope to have Allen, Alec Pierce (ankle) and Josh Downs (calf) all ready for Week 1. In all likelihood, Dulin is merely competing with Nick Westbrook-Ikhine for the No. 4 WR role at this point.

items.h: Dulin has impressed at OTAs and mandatory minicamp and is making a push for the No. 3 wide receiver role behind Alec Pierce (ankle) and Josh Downs, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.
items.s: Dulin said his approach has been "attacking [the offseason] as if it's my first year, knowing that, that [No. 3] spot is open." After the Colts traded Michael Pittman to Pittsburgh, Stephen Holder of ESPN concurs Dulin has taken an early lead for the No. 3 role over Nick Westbrook-Ikhine, Laquon Treadwell and rookie seventh-round pick Deion Burks and was a standout at minicamp. Offensive coordinator Jim Bob Cooter said Dulin has been moving around the offensive formation at practice and "can be really good for us this year on offense." The 29-year-old totaled a 5-106-0 line across 12…

items.h: Dulin could not secure either of his two targets during Sunday's 38-30 season-finale loss to Houston.
items.s: Dulin suited up for 12 regular-season appearances with the Colts in 2025, during which span he secured five of 10 targets for 106 receiving yards and logged three carries for 44 rushing yards. He also compiled a career-high 516 yards as a kick returner. He has one more year on his contract with Indianapolis, though the team has a potential "out" this offseason for only $670,000 in dead cap.

items.h: Dulin (hamstring) has had his injury designation removed for Sunday's game against Jacksonville.
items.s: Dulin was initially listed as questionable to play Sunday, but after being activated from IR on Saturday he's now had that designation removed entirely. He'll be available to operate as a depth option in Indianapolis' wide receiver corps versus the Jaguars as well as to contribute on kick returns due to Anthony Gould (foot) having been placed on IR.

items.h: Dulin (hamstring) has been activated from injured reserve Saturday and remains questionable for Sunday's contest against the Jaguars.
items.s: Dulin is now eligible to suit up for Sunday's divisional matchup against Jacksonville, though his status may not be made official until roughly 90 minutes prior to the contest's 1:00 p.m. ET kickoff. If cleared to play in Week 17, expect Dulin to resume handling his usual depth role on offense while also contributing in the return game.

items.h: The Colts designated Dulin (hamstring) for return from IR on Wednesday, Mike Chappell of Fox 59 News Indianapolis reports.
items.s: Dulin landed on injured reserve Nov. 25 due to a hamstring injury. He's since missed the required four games and, with his designation to return, is eligible to be activated at any time. Indianapolis has 21 days to decide whether to activate Dulin, but he could play as soon as this Sunday against the Dolphins. Prior to getting hurt, he had a minor role in the passing game and was also serving as one of the team's top kick returners.

items.h: The Colts placed Dulin (hamstring) on injured reserve Tuesday.
items.s: It's unclear when Dulin suffered the injury, but he'll now be required to miss at least the Colts' next four contests. Through 10 games this season, Dulin has logged a 5-106-0 receiving line on 132 offensive snaps while also seeing 161 snaps on special teams. Anthony Gould and Laquon Treadwell are next up on the depth chart behind Michael Pittman, Alec Pierce and slot man Josh Downs.

items.h: Dulin had one reception for 48 yards on his only target in Sunday's loss at Kansas City.
items.s: Dulin played nine snaps on offense. He's taken over as the clear fourth receiver after the trade of Adonai Mitchell, but has just two targets over his last four games. He's still a star on special teams, the unit where he gets the most usage.

items.h: Dulin lost eight yards on his only reception in Sunday's 38-14 win over the Titans.
items.s: On the Colts' opening possession, Dulin ran backward on a short pass to dodge defenders, but his efforts proved unsuccessful as the Colts were forced to settle for a field goal when the drive stalled out. He finished the day with 13 snaps on offense, as Dulin got time late in the blowout win. Despite the relatively limited snap count, Dulin still saw the field more than Adonai Mitchell (nine snaps) and appears to be secure for now as the Colts' No. 4 wideout.

items.h: Dulin (chest) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.
items.s: Dulin wasn't able to suit up for Indianapolis' win over the Chargers in Week 7, but he's now healthy and on track to retake the field Sunday at home versus Tennessee. With Josh Downs (concussion) limited at practice but still uncertain for Week 8, Dulin could get a chance to handle increased reps behind Michael Pittman and Alec Pierce.

items.h: Dulin (chest) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chargers, Amanda Foster of the Colts' official site reports.
items.s: Adonai Mitchell and Anthony Gould could get additional opportunities in the absences of both Dulin and Josh Downs (concussion). Dulin's next chance to play will come at home against the Titans in Week 8.

items.h: Dulin (chest) will remain a nonparticipant in practice Friday, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.
items.s: Dulin has not practiced at all this week, suggesting he will likely be ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chargers. The same is true for Josh Downs (concussion), so Adonai Mitchell has a nice opportunity to take on an increased role alongside Michael Pittman and Alec Pierce if Mitchell can get back in the coaching staff's good graces. Anthony Gould rounds out the wide receiver depth chart.

items.h: Dulin (chest) remained a non-participant in practice Thursday, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.
items.s: Fellow wide receiver Josh Downs (concussion) remained sidelined Thursday as well. If neither Downs nor Dulin suit up Sunday against the Chargers, Adonai Mitchell or Anthony Gould would slide into three-receiver sets alongside Michael Pittman and Alec Pierce. Dulin could take on a larger role if he recovers in time to play Sunday and Downs doesn't.

items.h: Dulin did not participate in Wednesday's practice due to a chest injury.
items.s: Dulin likely picked up the injury during the Colts' 31-27 win over the Cardinals in Week 6, when he returned two kickoffs for 59 yards while playing just one snap on offense. The 28-year-old wideout will have two more opportunities to return to practice in at least a limited capacity ahead of Sunday's road game against the Chargers.

items.h: Dulin had two kick returns for an average of 29.5 yards in Sunday's win over Arizona. He played just one snap on offense.
items.s: Dulin had five targets and two receptions for 55 yards the previous week against Las Vegas, but moved back to a bench role with Alec Pierce returning from a concussion. Dulin is a key player on special teams but could still be used as a fourth receiver, as he may have moved ahead of Adonai Mitchell on the depth chart. Mitchell was a healthy inactive for Sunday's game.

items.h: Dulin had two receptions for 55 yards on five targets in Sunday's win over Las Vegas. He got the start at receiver in a three-receiver set and played on 47 of the offense's 66 snaps.
items.s: Dulin moved into the starting lineup with Alec Pierce (concussion) missing his second straight game and with Adonai Mitchell demoted due to dropping the football prior to passing the goal line to wipe out a would-be 76-yard touchdown and then committing a holding penalty to negate a 53-yard touchdown in Week 4. Mitchell played just six snaps late in the game after it became a blowout win. Dulin could stay in a top three receiver role if both Pierce and Mitchell remain out of the mix next week against Arizona.

items.h: Dulin could see increased snaps in Sunday's game against the Raiders as the Colts' No. 3 receiver behind Michael Pittman and Josh Downs, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.
items.s: Alec Pierce (concussion) is set to miss his second straight game, once again leaving a void in the Indianapolis receiver corps. While Pierce was sidelined for last Sunday's 27-20 loss to the Rams, Adonai Mitchell stepped in as the Colts' No. 3 wideout and played 89 percent of snaps while finishing with three catches for 96 yards on four targets. However, after dropping the football prior to passing the goal line to wipe out a would-be 76-yard touchdown and then committing a holding penalty to negate a 53-yard Jonathan Taylor touchdown run later in the game, Mitchell is active for Week 5 but…

items.h: Dulin had one carry on a reverse for 15 yards in Sunday's win over Miami. He played on 10 of the offense's 73 snaps but did not have a target in the passing game. He also had one kick return for 27 yards.
items.s: Dulin is the No. 5 receiver and key special-teams player who is used on gadget plays on offense. He's been productive when elevated to a larger role on the offense, but he's not going to get many targets unless there are injuries elsewhere in the receiving corps. Dulin looked fully healthy after missing time in the preseason due to a concussion.

items.h: Dulin (concussion) did not appear on the Colts' injury report Wednesday.
items.s: Dulin was sidelined with a concussion to close the preseason, but he has now returned to a log a full practice Wednesday. The wide receiver will open the season as more of a special-teams option than an offensive asset, but he'll be active nonetheless in Sunday's matchup with the Dolphins.

items.h: Head coach Shane Steichen told reporters Monday that Dulin has been "progressing well" in his recovery from a concussion that he sustained during practice last week, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.
items.s: The injury forced Dulin to miss the Colts' preseason finale against the Bengals on Saturday. He'll need to clear the league's five-step concussion protocol in order to be available for the Colts' Week 1 contest against the Dolphins on Sunday, Sept. 7. Dulin finished the 2024 regular season with two catches (on eight targets) for 67 yards and a touchdown while adding five carries for 45 yards and 148 kick-return yards across 15 regular-season games.

items.h: Dulin had three receptions for 54 yards on seven targets in Thursday's preseason loss to Baltimore.
items.s: Dulin started at wide receiver with most starters sitting out the game and led the team in receiving yards. Dulin is a key special teams player and has shown a spark at times on offense, but may not get many snaps on offense as the No. 5 wide receiver.

items.h: The Colts re-signed Dulin to a two-year contract Monday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
items.s: The deal is worth up to $8.5 million. Dulin doesn't contribute much on offense, but he's a stalwart on special teams for the Colts. Dulin has a total of 35 catches for 517 yards and four touchdowns since entering the NFL in 2019 as an undrafted free agent out of Malone.

items.h: Dulin secured two of eight targets for 67 yards and one touchdown across 15 regular-season appearances with the Colts in 2024. He also rushed five times for 45 yards and compiled 148 yards on kick returns.
items.s: Dulin spent the 2024 campaign contributing largely in a depth role on offense for Indianapolis while also handling a career-high 292 snaps on special teams. On offense, Dulin largely operated as a blocker or occasional deep threat. He's set to become an unrestricted free agent this offseason.

items.h: Dulin (ankle) is not among the Colts' inactives for their Week 16 matchup against Tennessee on Sunday.
items.s: Dulin logged a full practice Friday, though he entered the weekend with a questionable tag. He'll ultimately be able to play through his ankle injury after missing each of Indianapolis past two games. Dulin could see more offensive reps than usual with Alec Pierce (concussion) inactive for Sunday's contest, though Dulin shouldn't be counted on by fantasy managers for production given that he hasn't recorded a catch since Week 2.

items.h: Dulin (ankle) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Titans.
items.s: Dulin was able to get in a full practice Friday following a limited session Thursday. With Alec Pierce (concussion) ruled out, Dulin and rookie Adonai Mitchell are expected to see increased snaps behind Michael Pittman and Josh Downs. Dulin has missed the last two games and is known more for his blocking prowess at the position. He has two catches for 67 yards and one touchdown this season but hasn't caught a pass since Week 2.

items.h: Dulin (ankle) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice.
items.s: Dulin has been sidelined for the Colts' last two games due to an ankle injury he suffered against the Lions in Week 12. His return to practice Thursday indicates that he is progressing in his recovery, and logging a full practice Friday would put him on track to play against the Titans on Sunday. Dulin has been held without a catch since Week 2 against the Packers.

items.h: Dulin (ankle) is ruled out for Sunday's game against the Broncos.
items.s: Dulin won't be available for the Colts in Week 15 due to an ankle injury that's kept him sidelined since he initially suffered it Week 12 against Detroit. With Dulin unavailable, rookie fifth-round pick Anthony Gould could get a chance to contribute in a depth role on offense, as well as on special teams.

items.h: Dulin (ankle) is not participating in the portion of Thursday's practice open to the media, Nate Atkins of The Indianapolis Star reports.
items.s: Dulin hasn't played since Week 12 due to an ankle injury, and despite the Colts being fresh off a bye, it appears the depth wideout is trending in the wrong direction for Sunday's road matchup against the Broncos. If Dulin is indeed unable to suit up versus Denver, his absence will most be felt by Indianapolis on special teams.

items.h: Dulin (ankle) didn't practice Wednesday.
items.s: Dulin missed the Colts' Week 13 win over the Patriots and has yet to return to practice since sustaining an ankle injury the game prior. The Malone product will likely be sidelined for the second consecutive game in a Week 15 matchup against the Broncos if he can't practice in a limited fashion Thursday or Friday. However, if he can play in Sunday's contest, he'll primarily add value to Indianapolis' special-teams unit.

items.h: Dulin (ankle) won't play in Sunday's game against New England, Amanda Foster of the Colts' official site reports.
items.s: Foster injured his ankle last Sunday against the Lions, and he won't suit up versus the Patriots after being unable to practice all week. The fifth-year wideout hasn't recorded a catch since Week 2, so his absence isn't likely to have a significant impact on Indianapolis' offensive game plan. The Colts are on bye next week, which will give Dulin extra time to try to recover in time for Week 15.
